structures.name: Story cold open
structures.description: Start mid-story with a cliffhanger, rewind to explain, resolve with a lesson. Works for tech, fitness, lifestyle.
structures.beatFlow: 0-3s: 'The moment I realized my data was gone' — 3-12s: how it started, normal day — 12-24s: the mistake escalates — 24-30s: the fix + the one lesson

structures.name: Problem / solution
structures.description: Name the pain in one line, show the cost of ignoring it, deliver a concrete fix, end with one action.
structures.beatFlow: 0-4s: 'Your downloads folder is slowing your Mac' — 4-10s: the hidden cost — 10-26s: three-step fix, each step on screen — 26-30s: do step one today

structures.name: Before / after
structures.description: Paint a vivid messy before, name the turning point, show after with specific numbers.
structures.beatFlow: 0-6s: the messy before, specific and visual — 6-14s: the single change — 14-26s: the after, real numbers — 26-30s: how to copy it

structures.name: Listicle
structures.description: Promise a specific count, move fast, each item gets one line and one visual.
structures.beatFlow: 0-4s: '4 apps I deleted in January' — 4-24s: one item per ~5s, escalating — 24-30s: the one that hurt the most

structures.name: Myth bust
structures.description: Quote the popular myth, explain why everyone believes it, destroy it with evidence, offer the replacement.
structures.beatFlow: 0-4s: 'Stretching prevents injuries — wrong' — 4-12s: why the myth spreads — 12-26s: the actual evidence — 26-30s: what to do instead

structures.name: Underdog
structures.description: Rock bottom in specific detail, the doubters, the method and grind, the comeback numbers.
structures.beatFlow: 0-6s: the lowest point — 6-14s: what everyone said — 14-24s: the unglamorous method — 24-30s: the result + one line of wisdom

structures.name: Challenge framing
structures.description: Dare the viewer with clear rules and a promise of what happens by day N.
structures.beatFlow: 0-4s: 'Do this for 7 days' — 4-12s: the exact rules — 12-24s: what changes and when — 24-30s: start today, tell me how it goes

structures.name: A vs B comparison
structures.description: Two options face off with honest pros and cons, ending in a clear verdict.
structures.beatFlow: 0-4s: 'Air fryer vs oven' — 4-14s: option A pros and cons — 14-24s: option B pros and cons — 24-30s: the verdict and who should pick what

structures.name: Mini documentary
structures.description: Neutral narrator tells a small true story with cinematic restraint.
structures.beatFlow: 0-5s: establishing line — 5-15s: the situation, neutral — 15-26s: the turning point — 26-30s: quiet earned conclusion

structures.name: Day in the life
structures.description: First-person routine with fast cuts and one unexpected moment near the end.
structures.beatFlow: 0-6s: morning setup — 6-20s: ordinary moments, quick — 20-27s: the one unexpected thing — 27-30s: a small reflection

structures.name: Reaction / breakdown
structures.description: React to a hot product, post or claim, then break down why it works or fails.
structures.beatFlow: 0-4s: show the thing — 4-12s: first unfiltered reaction — 12-26s: the breakdown — 26-30s: final verdict

structures.name: Speed tutorial
structures.description: Show the result first, then one action per line with on-screen text for every step.
structures.beatFlow: 0-3s: the finished result — 3-24s: steps, one per line — 24-30s: the one setting people miss

structures.name: Allegory
structures.description: Tell an unrelated small story that lands a big point about the topic.
structures.beatFlow: 0-7s: a tiny vivid story — 7-20s: the twist — 20-30s: the connection to your topic

structures.name: Prediction
structures.description: A bold claim about the future, then three signals that prove it, then what to do now.
structures.beatFlow: 0-4s: the bold prediction — 4-12s: why most people miss it — 12-25s: three signals — 25-30s: what to do this week

structures.name: Honest review
structures.description: A real test with specifics: the good, the bad, and whether you'd buy again.
structures.beatFlow: 0-4s: what I tested and what it cost — 4-14s: the good parts — 14-24s: the bad parts, no hedging — 24-30s: would I buy it again?

structures.name: Confession
structures.description: Admit something people hide, show how bad it got, then the change and the method.
structures.beatFlow: 0-6s: the confession — 6-14s: how bad it actually got — 14-24s: the turning point — 24-30s: what you can steal from it

structures.name: Dialogue sketch
structures.description: Two characters act out a typical scene, escalating until the punchline reveals the real point.
structures.beatFlow: 0-6s: set the scene, two characters — 6-20s: escalating dialogue — 20-26s: the punchline — 26-30s: the serious point underneath

structures.name: Countdown
structures.description: Count from N to 1 with rising importance; the last item is the payoff.
structures.beatFlow: 0-3s: start the countdown — 3-24s: items N..2, escalating stakes — 24-30s: number one, the payoff

structures.name: POV scenario
structures.description: Second person puts the viewer inside a scene until the realization lands.
structures.beatFlow: 0-7s: 'It's 2am and you can't sleep' — 7-18s: what happens next, sensory detail — 18-25s: the realization — 25-30s: what to do about it

structures.name: Origin story
structures.description: The surprising origin of a product, habit or phenomenon, with one forgotten detail.
structures.beatFlow: 0-5s: the surprising origin claim — 5-18s: how it actually happened — 18-26s: the forgotten detail — 26-30s: why it still matters
